cards.note: "Doubted themselves more" goes a bit beyond the study. Daters aged 18 to 30 accepted fewer profiles the longer they went, and grew more pessimistic about being liked back. Say that.
Right: 155 people aged 18 to 32, within 11 weeks of a break-up; 71% reported high growth.

Accurate, but cholesterol is an odd reason to write a love letter. If the card stays on two mindsets only (see the pretend people), a study on closeness or mood after expressing love would read better.
